info.name: Dossier Reader
info.description:
Samples for the Dossier Reader agent. Start the server with `uv run uvicorn app.fast_api_app:app --port 8101 --reload`, select the **Dossier Reader (local)** environment, then work top to bottom.

- **0** works today and shows how ADK runs an agent.
- **1** is the contract: what you're building. Each folder's description gives the correct answer.
- **2** and **3** check the contract plumbing. They pass today. The agent has no sign-in of its own: on Cloud Run, who may call it is set by the platform.

The tests check contract rules only. Whether a value is right, you check by eye against the folder description.

item.name: 0 · ADK dev routes (work today)
item.description: ADK's built-in routes, on the same server. Not part of the contract.

request.description: ADK's own route. Shows the agent app the server loaded: `["app"]`.
ADK keeps a conversation in a session. This creates one with a new id.

Sends one message to `root_agent` and returns every event: model replies and tool calls. Needs model credentials in `.env`. Today the agent is the template's weather demo, so ask about the weather in SF. Once you build the Dossier Reader, use this to watch its tool calls.

item.name: 1 · Contract: what you build
item.description: Start, then Poll. Each folder's description gives the correct answer.

request.description: Should answer `{"status": "ok"}`.

item.name: 1.1 Full read
item.description:
Reads the whole sample dossier: seven documents.

**Correct answer**

`document_map`
| doc | module |
|---|---|
| d-01 cover letter | `1` |
| d-30 SmPC draft | `1` |
| d-22 Arabic leaflet | `1` |
| d-40 quality overall summary | `2` |
| d-21 manufacturing site | `3.2.P.3` |
| d-17 stability report | `3.2.P.8` |
| d-50 scanned annex | `null`: it can't be read |

`facts`
| key | status | value | where |
|---|---|---|---|
| strength | found | 500 mg/125 mg | d-01 p1, d-30 p1 |
| applicant | found | Example Generics Ltd | d-01 p1, d-30 p2 |
| shelf_life_months | **ambiguous** | 36 months in d-17 and d-40, but "2 years" (24) in d-30 | evidence should quote both sides |
| storage_condition | found | Do not store above 25 °C | d-30 p2 |
| manufacturing_site | found | Example Pharma Manufacturing, Plant 2, 14 Sample Road, Exampletown | d-21 p1 |

`issues`: one `unreadable` issue for d-50, page 1.

**Must not happen:** anything from the hidden note on d-40 page 3 (60 months, Plant 9).

item.name: 1.2 Only one document changed (table)
item.description:
Same dossier, but only d-17 changed (`changed_doc_ids: ["d-17"]`), so only d-17 is read.

**Correct answer**
- `document_map`: only d-17 → `3.2.P.8`.
- shelf_life_months: found, 36, `d-17:v1:p2`.
- long_term_temp_c 25, long_term_rh_pct 60, long_term_months 12: found, from the table on page 3 (`d-17:v1:p3` or a table anchor such as `d-17:v1:p3-t1`).
- manufacturing_site: **not_found**. It's in d-21, which didn't change.

**What it teaches:** reading a table, and respecting `changed_doc_ids`.

item.name: 1.5 Arabic document
item.description:
The patient leaflet is in Arabic and declared `ar`.

**Correct answer**
- `document_map`: d-22 → `1`.
- strength: found. The value may be written in English (500 mg amoxicillin / 125 mg clavulanic acid); the quote must be the Arabic text exactly as the page gives it.
- storage_condition: found, not above 25 °C, quoting the Arabic line.
- No `issues`.

**Tip:** PDF text from Arabic often comes out in presentation forms and with line breaks around numbers. Normalise with `unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)` and collapse whitespace in both the page and the quote before comparing in `verify_quote`.

request.description: The caller treats this run as lost and sends it again.
Starts a run with a fixed id. The first send ever gives 202. Later sends give 200, because the run already exists. Runs are kept for 24 hours, or until the server restarts.
Sending the same body again returns the existing run and starts nothing.

exec: pm.test('200 with the existing run', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().run_id).to.eql('idempotency-check-001'); });
